title: PixyLite
description: PixyLite is a lightweight Vanilla+ SMP modpack focused on performance, stability, and smooth multiplayer gameplay, no bloat, just Minecraft refined.
body:
PixyLite — Lightweight SMP Modpack

Pure Survival. Smooth Performance. Multiplayer Ready.

PixyLite is a lightweight, performance-focused SMP modpack designed for players who want a clean Vanilla+ experience without unnecessary bloat. Built and maintained by PlanetPixy, PixyLite delivers smooth gameplay, essential quality-of-life improvements, and full multiplayer compatibility — even on lower-end systems.

Whether you’re joining a public SMP or hosting your own server, PixyLite keeps Minecraft fast, stable, and fun.

✨ Key Features

Lightweight & optimized — minimal mods, maximum performance

Vanilla+ gameplay — enhanced, not overcomplicated

Multiplayer ready — perfect for SMP servers

Low hardware requirements — runs smoothly on most PCs

Actively maintained — frequent updates and fixes

🧩 Included Improvements

Performance and FPS optimizations

Essential QoL mods (UI, controls, visuals)

Stability-focused configuration

Server-friendly mod selection

🎮 Best Experience

PixyLite is the recommended modpack for PlanetPixy SMP, but works flawlessly on any Fabric-based multiplayer server.

No tech mods. No forced progression. Just Minecraft — refined.
